functional_scope: Central Gray AW and CA service; central and remote Gray Firewall/Encryption Components protect management between sites through separate Outer protection. Management terminates on the remote Outer dedicated management interface. A separate Red data path remains useful while the Gray management encryption layer is down.
limitations: Supplemental Linux-netns/static-routing backend; native FRR/OVS profiles are retained separately.
Manually provisioned ephemeral test SAs establish finite encryption behavior, not IKE/credential authentication for the two IPsec layers. TLS authenticates the test AW/server.
Complete Enterprise Gray Annex controls, product independence, registration, personnel and approval remain unchecked.
Public CA service is a test trust-publication endpoint, not a certified production enrollment service.
